description: This dataset compiles human observations of the plant species Antennaria racemosa, primarily sourced from iNaturalist. It includes 20 records documenting occurrences across Canada and the United States, with specific details on provinces and states such as Alberta, British Columbia, Washington, and Oregon. Each entry provides precise taxonomic classification, geographic coordinates, and event dates ranging from 2011 to 2026. The data features associated media, including still images, and records the individuals who identified and recorded the sightings. Researchers can utilize this collection to analyze the species' distribution patterns, phenology, and habitat preferences in North American ecosystems.
